fields: (a table, as "router"): h, intro, cols [check, route, does not prove, time], rows (cells strings or {t, link, intent}), fold, fold_noun.
best_for: CheckLedger sets a router table of checks a buyer can run before a case study exists as a ledger of tiles: each check is one row headed by a navy slash-numeral tile, then the route to arrange it, what you check, what it does not prove, and the time to arrange in mono at the right edge.
